content.what_it_is: A V35/0x24 text-form compiler interface artifact for calculate_mean_module, generated from mixing_gpu.f90. It records CUDA/NVIDIA/cuTENSOR/reduction dependencies, grid and timing inputs, output switches, host and device mean/sum/wave-height fields, GPU kernels that accumulate sums and calculate means, a device-to-host mean transfer procedure, and a higher-level mixing/mean procedure set, followed by compiler type/symbol/argument tables (lines 1-1053).
